description: The Earth Monkey in Chinese astrology: personality, Earth element traits, 1968 and 2028 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Earth Monkey is the Monkey born in a Earth year, one of five versions of the ninth animal. It combines the Monkey's ingenuity with Earth's qualities. Earth Monkey years between 1924 and 2044 are 1968 and 2028. The Monkey's fixed element is Metal.

sections.heading: The Earth Monkey personality
paragraphs: In the generating cycle Earth produces Metal, and the Monkey always carries Metal, so an Earth year is said to nourish and steady the animal, giving its quicksilver mind solid footing. Earth Monkeys are often described as the most reliable and grounded Monkeys: intelligent, practical and conscientious, with a talent for turning ideas into workable systems. They tend to be generous with knowledge and kind to people they trust. Their humour is usually gentler and their ambitions more measured than other Monkeys'. That supportive foundation brings stability. It can also bring a touch of self-importance, and Earth Monkeys may become rigid in their opinions or reluctant to admit when a well-built plan is not working.

In classical thought, Earth belongs to the centre and to the late-summer pause between seasons, the point where things ripen and settle. As a year stem, it tends to slow an animal down in a useful way, adding prudence, loyalty and a strong sense of responsibility. People born under an Earth stem are often described as dependable, sensible and protective of the people they love. They value security and tend to build carefully. The caution traditionally attached to Earth is caution itself: overthinking, clinging to the familiar and carrying other people's problems as though they were their own.

sections.heading: Earth Monkey at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Earth is usually associated with management, organisation and long-term stewardship. Earth-year people are often described as the steady hands who keep systems running, look after budgets and notice when colleagues are struggling, which suits administration, property, finance, agriculture, healthcare and operations. They tend to earn trust slowly and keep it. The traditional caution is resistance to change: an Earth stem may hold on to a process after it has stopped working, so regular reviews and a willingness to experiment help.

The Earth Monkey channels the sign's ingenuity into practical, reliable results. Engineering, consultancy, technical teaching, logistics and small-business management are commonly named, because clever fixes have to work in the real world there. It enjoys solving genuine problems for actual clients and tends to earn trust by being both inventive and dependable. In relationships, the Earth Monkey is warm, loyal and helpful, often the friend who arrives with a toolbox and stays for supper. It needs respect for its competence and a companion who values steadiness. Friction comes from pride in being right: it may correct a partner's approach to a task rather than letting them learn their own way.

sections.heading: Earth Monkey years and dates
paragraphs: Earth Monkey years in the Lunar New Year table run from January 30, 1968 to February 16, 1969 and from January 26, 2028 to February 12, 2029. Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1968 anyone born before Jan 30 is a Fire Goat, not a Earth Monkey. Sixty years separate each Earth Monkey year, the length of a full round of five elements and twelve animals. Every Earth Monkey year is Yang, matching the Monkey's own polarity.

Its traditional name is Wu-Shen: Wu is the yang Earth stem and Shen is the Monkey's branch. Births just before each new year fall in the Fire Goat year (before January 30, 1968) and the Fire Goat year (before January 26, 2028), and births in the weeks after each Earth Monkey year ends belong to the Earth Rooster. The new year itself fell on a Tuesday in 1968 and Wednesday in 2028.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Earth Monkey
paragraphs: For an Earth Monkey, intellectual humility keeps the mind as nimble as it naturally is. Actively seeking out people who think differently, and asking what they might be missing, prevents comfortable assumptions from hardening. Earth Monkeys often excel at mentoring, administration and practical innovation, and roles that use all three tend to satisfy them. Because they are dependable, others may lean heavily on them, so saying no occasionally preserves balance. Making time for pure play, puzzles, games, travel, keeps the Monkey spirit lively. With openness alongside their steadiness, Earth Monkeys combine brilliance and reliability rarely found together.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Earth Monkey shares the Monkey's San He trine with the Rat and Dragon (the Water trine), its Liu He bond with the Snake, and its Liu Chong clash with the Tiger. The element adds a second layer: another Earth sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Earth in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Earth Monkey years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1968 (from January 30, 1968) and 2028 (from January 26, 2028). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Earth Monkey's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Earth and the Monkey's fixed element is Metal; in the five-element cycles earth generates Metal. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Earth Monkey?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Rat and Dragon (San He) and the Snake (Liu He). The Tiger is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Earth Monkey called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Wu-Shen. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Earth stem Wu, followed by its earthly branch, here Shen for the Monkey, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Earth Monkey different from other Monkeys?
faq.answer: All Monkeys share ingenuity, humour and curiosity. The Earth year element changes the tone: earth sits at the centre of the five-element wheel, and an Earth year is traditionally said to give any animal steadiness, patience and a practical turn of mind.
